description: Makes the coarse filter's hard boundary visible in the UI, per ARCHITECTURE.md limitation 7.
docstring:
Presentation-ready funnel summary for one run.

Attributes:
    catalog_size: From analysis_results['funnel_report'] (acquisition.FunnelResult.total_input, persisted via write_analysis_result in run_acquisition).
    candidate_count: acquisition.FunnelResult candidate count.
    simple_subset_size: analysis.AnalysisReport.simple_subset_size.
    rejected_by_reason: acquisition.FunnelResult.rejected_by_reason, merged for display with analysis's simplicity-stage rejected_by_reason under distinctly prefixed keys (e.g. 'coarse_filter.review_count_below_floor' vs 'simplicity_filter.above_simplicity_threshold') so the two funnel stages are not conflated in one flat dict.
postconditions: rejected_by_reason keys are unambiguously prefixed by stage

edge_cases.input: A run whose acquisition stage failed before completing (no funnel_report yet)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: load_run_report constructs FunnelSummary with catalog_size=0, candidate_count=0, an empty rejected_by_reason, and relies on RunReport.is_partial=True to signal the incompleteness to the UI rather than raising

edge_cases.input: candidate_count == catalog_size (an implausibly permissive coarse filter)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: rendered as-is; reporting does not second-guess or reject an unusual-looking funnel, only displays it

unit_tests.name: test_funnel_summary_ordering_invariant
unit_tests.description: For a normal completed run fixture, simple_subset_size <= candidate_count <= catalog_size holds.

unit_tests.name: test_missing_funnel_report_yields_zeroed_summary
unit_tests.description: A run with no funnel_report analysis_results row yields an all-zero FunnelSummary rather than raising.
